exclusions.name: Elena Cruz
exclusions.why_safe: She oversees receipts but does not control collection rate or shipping schedule; her actions do not affect the number of units received.

exclusions.name: Other hospitals or blood centres
exclusions.why_safe: No evidence suggests any other entities supply or receive blood from St. Vincent; the distribution agreement only mentions the Cascade centre and St. Vincent.

exclusions.name: Weekend collection (Saturday/Sunday)
exclusions.why_safe: The drive is only open Monday to Friday; weekend collection does not occur.

exclusions.name: Friday collection
exclusions.why_safe: The deadline is Friday noon; collection on Friday after 9 AM could add units but they would not be shipped until the next scheduled shipment (Tuesday), so they do not affect hospital stock by Friday noon.
